{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values:", sales_df.isnull().sum().to_dict())

# Check for duplicates
print("Duplicate rows:", sales_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check the unique values in status and converted
print("Unique values in status:", sales_df['status'].unique())
print("Unique values in converted:", sales_df['converted'].unique())

# Check the data type of revenue
print("Revenue data type:", sales_df['revenue'].dtype)

# Inspect the revenue values to see the formatting
print("Sample revenue values:", sales_df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())"}
